current_answer: As of 23 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC, no broad cross-model core-capability decline is proven. OpenAI recorded resolved ChatGPT Conversations errors from 09:13 to 09:54 UTC, while Claude and xAI status pages showed no active incident at the check. A detailed same-account report supplies a stronger Chat-versus-Work execution-class lead—ordinary Chat foreground turns around 25–26 minutes versus historical Chat and current Work worker handoff—but the route predicate and prevalence are not provider-confirmed. Capacity, automatic-switching, and requested-Astra/returned-Luna reports are access and provenance leads, not broad weight evidence. An independent RoboDojo paper is a positive cross-sectional counterweight. Replay one fixed task with requested and served model, surface, route, context, effort, budget, artifact, and control before calling degradation.

catalogue_card.question: Are popular AI models getting worse right now?
catalogue_card.text: OpenAI had a short ChatGPT outage. The stronger new lead is a Chat-versus-Work execution split, but it still does not prove the models got worse.

summary: No broad cross-model core-capability decline is proven.
OpenAI recorded resolved ChatGPT Conversations errors from 09:13 to 09:54 UTC on 23 September; that is availability evidence.
Claude and xAI status pages showed no active incident at the check.
A detailed same-account report gives a narrow Chat-versus-Work execution-class lead, but it is not provider-confirmed or a prevalence estimate.
Capacity, automatic switching, and requested-Astra/returned-Luna reports make served-model and route receipts necessary before judging quality.
An independent RoboDojo paper is a positive cross-sectional Astra counterweight, not a temporal production test.

Reader move: record task, surface, requested and served model, execution class, route, context, budget, artifact, correction burden, and control before retrying, waiting, stopping, switching, or replaying.
uncertainty: No matched Chat-versus-Work or cross-provider fixed-task series with provider-served model, route receipts, representative denominator, human pilot, provider ledger, or willingness-to-pay evidence is available.
Provider status pages establish declared service conditions, not account-level task quality or prevalence.
Community route, capacity, and model-ID reports are self-selected and not independently verified.
The RoboDojo result is cross-sectional and task-specific; it does not test temporal production-route degradation.
Judge or harness version, task configuration, context, safety behavior, access, and product execution can all move a measured or perceived result.
freshness_note: Fresh public-source research completed 23 September 2026. The broad call remains no capability decline proven; a resolved OpenAI availability incident, a narrow Chat-versus-Work execution lead, provenance reports, and a positive independent counterweight sharpen the next replay.
